scientific_review.review_scope: The following are candidate-preprint findings only. Strong contribution evidence is not automatically transferred to the conflicted canonical proceeding record.
scientific_review.contribution_locator: PDFp2 Introduction contributions; pp3-4 MIRAGE Dataset/Construction/Partition; pp6-7 Experiments and Tables2-5; pp12-17 appendix Dataset Details.

data_resource.name: MIRAGE
data_resource.construction: WebsitesA/B and LAION data; retain unanimous expert real/fake labels agreeing with original platform tags, remove uncertain/disagreeing cases. Add vanilla and composite generator outputs plus VLM reasoning annotations and final expert quality filtering.
data_resource.reuse_intent: Named separate first contribution, dedicated construction/partition sections and released-resource intent; abstract says benchmark/code will be made public. Availability, license and actual release were not independently established.

benchmark_protocol.design: SourceA/LAION for training/ID; unseen sourceB and generator/pipeline classes for human-curated and eight-pattern OOD sets. Compare five specialized detectors, three closed-source zero-shot VLMs and three fine-tuned foundation VLMs, with accuracy/precision/recall and separate Chameleon transfer testing.
benchmark_protocol.R1_support_on_candidate: Explicitly curated and systematically constructed reusable resource, not experiment-only data.
benchmark_protocol.R2_support_on_candidate: Explicit source/generator-disjoint evaluation partitions and named categories, metrics, baselines and cross-benchmark comparison; this independent protocol provision, not the number of generators or large tables, supports benchmark.

quantitative_evidence.finding: MIRAGE-R1 ID accuracy97.26,OOD-C78.46, mean72.81. Gemini2.5-Pro mean67.26 but OOD-C82.30. Thus mean advantage is5.55 percentage points, while the proposed method does not lead OOD-C.

OnChameleon, MIRAGE-R1 ALL78.31,FAKE50.29,REAL98.37. CNNSpot* trained onGenImage hasALL68.89, whileCNNSpot trained onMIRAGE hasALL64.21. Comparisons do not establish blanket superiority of the training dataset on every aggregate metric.
HA-R adaptive OOD-C78.46 versus final-answer-only78.13 and initial guess-reason-answer75.25. These are reported outcomes, not independent proof of causal reasoning fidelity.

limitations_and_conflicts.finding: OuCheng Huang in DOI registration/canonical record versus Cheng Xia in arXivmetadata and fullv1 manuscript. Eight coauthors and exact title match; neither equivalence nor nonidentity is forced.
PDFp4 main partition gives20000 training images; PDFp16 appendix Data Distribution says2000. Preserve both, do not select or silently correct a value.
PDFp4 describes64 pipelines integrating53 models; PDFp16 describes64 different models. The distinct-count relationship is not reconciled by the reviewed text.
Mainp6 describes64H20 GPUs forSFT and batch8; appendixp17 describes8H20 GPUs and effective global batch64. This affects reproducibility interpretation, not contribution status.
Mainp7 broad OOD superiority wording is limited byTable2: Gemini OOD-C82.30 exceeds MIRAGE78.46; the5.55point mean advantage is not an advantage on every subset.

Human labels use trained visual judgment plus platform tags, not independently audited creation provenance. Anonymous proprietary sources, uncertainty filtering, release/license uncertainty and temporal skew2022-2025 constrain reuse and validity claims.
PDFp7 Table5 labels Gaussian blur, while adjacent prose refers to Gaussian noise; preserve the mismatch.
